svg.title: Lasutriv — Circuit Trace banner
svg.desc: Lasutriv. ROLE: Game developer · autonomous AI agents. LATEST: Monarchy · New Roots. ASSET: AIA-Evolve, an AI agent that ships code 24/7. A circuit board: the name is etched on a chip, and signal pulses run along copper traces to three components, lighting an LED at each.
